feature_request: Add rate limiting to the login endpoint
acceptance_criteria: When a successful login occurs, the endpoint returns HTTP 200 and sets the session cookie.
When the maximum allowed login attempts (e.g., 5 within 10 minutes) are exceeded, the endpoint returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with a message indicating the rate limit.
When an unauthenticated client accesses the login endpoint, the endpoint returns HTTP 200 and renders the login form without allowing a login submission.
When the login form is submitted with a CSRF token missing or invalid, the endpoint returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with an error message about CSRF validation.
plan: Implement rate limiting on the login endpoint by adding a new Redis-backed limiter in flaskbb/login.py and updating the login view to check the limiter before processing. Use existing Redis utilities for connection management. Add a schema validation for the new form field. No new files required.
